data.analysis_policy: Fit the nonnegative exponential-approach mean a*(1-exp(-b*x)) by unweighted native-response least squares,without an offset. Assess the fitted fractional gap from its asymptote at the largest observed pressure; this reporting panel calls the observed pressure range near saturation only when that gap<=0.10. Suggested feasible start a500,b0.0001; other converged solutions are valid.
data.units: Original archive pressure/adsorbed-volume numbers; no unstated physical unit conversion.
